cards.title: Treble Raises $18M for Voice Simulation Platform
cards.body: Iceland-based Treble secured $18 million for its voice simulation technology used by AI model developers, wearable companies, and robotics firms. The platform enables advanced voice AI capabilities across multiple industries.

cards.title: Building Teams with AI Agents at TechCrunch Disrupt
cards.body: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will showcase how early-stage companies integrate human and AI agent teammates. Founders will learn strategies to maintain speed, accountability, and culture while scaling with AI.

cards.title: Snap Defends $2,200 Smart Glasses Value Proposition
cards.body: Snap continues advocating for its Specs smart glasses since their earlier 2026 launch. The company seeks to clarify the device's market positioning and unique capabilities.

cards.title: Al Gore Prioritizes AI Safety Over Data Centers
cards.body: Al Gore expressed greater concern about AI industry risks than data center emissions in a TechCrunch interview. He emphasized focusing on the technology's trajectory warnings from AI companies themselves.

cards.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Embed Independent Safety Evaluators
cards.body: Anthropic and OpenAI plan to embed independent safety evaluators within their AI labs for unprecedented oversight access. Researchers welcome the transparency initiative but stress the need for genuine independence and eventual regulation.

cards.title: Meta Launches Camera-Free Smart Glasses Version
cards.body: Meta is developing a camera-free smart glasses variant to address privacy concerns. The move aims to counter 'pervert glasses' criticism plaguing the connected eyewear category.

cards.title: AI Lab Security Needs Better Access Controls
cards.body: Experts suggest AI labs should implement simpler security measures before deploying in-house auditors. Better access controls could prevent rogue agent incidents more effectively than after-the-fact oversight.

cards.title: Google Enables AI Agents to Control Smart Homes
cards.body: Google launched early access to an MCP server for Google Home, allowing AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to control connected devices and access camera summaries. Users can now manage smart homes using natural language through multiple AI platforms.

cards.title: Anthropic Unifies Claude Chat and Cowork Interface
cards.body: Anthropic merged its Claude chat and Cowork features into a single interface for streamlined user experience. Pro and Max subscribers gain initial access to the consolidated platform.

cards.title: Nvidia Eyes ChatGPT Moment for Robotics Industry
cards.body: Nvidia's Les Karpas will discuss why robotics still lacks a mainstream breakthrough similar to ChatGPT at Disrupt 2026. The session explores barriers to everyday robot adoption.

cards.title: Threads Rolls Out Podcast Promotion Tools
cards.body: Meta's Threads added profile cards, episode links, transcripts, guest tags, and audience insights for podcasters. The platform aims to become a major hub for podcast discovery and community discussion.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Judges Announced
cards.body: Five top-tier venture investors were revealed as judges for Startup Battlefield 200 at Disrupt 2026. Early registration closes September 25 with up to $200 in savings available.

cards.title: Final Days to Exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
cards.body: Booth reservations close September 18 with three days remaining to exhibit at Disrupt. Companies can reach 10,000+ founders, investors, and tech leaders October 13–15.

cards.title: SK Hynix Discusses US Memory Chip Production
cards.body: SK Hynix is reportedly negotiating with Intel regarding memory chip manufacturing in the United States. The company stated no final plans or arrangements have been confirmed yet.

cards.title: Former Infosys Chief's AI Startup Raises $53M
cards.body: The Palo Alto-based AI startup secured an additional $53 million in funding. Within months of launch, the company has already closed multiple seven-figure enterprise contracts.

cards.title: Amazon Launches Alexa+ in India with Hindi
cards.body: Amazon released Alexa+ in India during early access with Hindi language support. All customers can now access the advanced assistant tier.

cards.title: Nvidia's Huang: AI Safety Doesn't Need Regulation
cards.body: Nvidia's Jensen Huang argued AI is simply hardware and software, not 'alien intelligence,' and safety can be engineered by individual product makers. He opposed external AI regulation, favoring industry-led safety approaches.

cards.title: AI Data Centers Collide with Industrial Communities
cards.body: Philadelphia faces proposed data center construction in neighborhoods already scarred by defunct oil refineries. National opposition to AI infrastructure expansion intensifies across multiple cities.

cards.title: Meta Automates WhatsApp Business Setup with AI
cards.body: Meta released a WhatsApp Business MCP server enabling AI agents like Claude to handle setup, templates, testing, and troubleshooting. Developers can now automate business communication workflows.

cards.title: The AI Graveyard: Failed Projects and Startups
cards.body: A comprehensive list tracks AI projects that shut down or missed expectations, from Apple's delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's troubled 'super app' launch. The collection documents the AI industry's failures alongside its successes.

cards.title: Building the materials foundation for AI
cards.body: As AI advances, semiconductors and data centers are hitting physical limits in performance and thermal management. Materials science is becoming as crucial as algorithms for supporting the AI boom.

cards.title: AI's trillion-dollar gamble explained
cards.body: Finance experts are assessing AI's economic impact over the next few years amid significant business and technical uncertainties. The stakes are extraordinarily high for both investors and the industry.

cards.title: Could AI really kill us all?
cards.body: Employees at leading AI labs warn of real extinction risks from advanced AI systems. Experts debate whether these concerns represent genuine threats or industry hype.

cards.title: AI models need biology data
cards.body: OpenAI is funding efforts to create specialized biological datasets for training medical AI systems. The strategy includes acquiring data from failed biotech companies' regulatory filings.

cards.title: AI industry takes doomer turn
cards.body: Major AI leaders including Dario Amodei and Sam Altman are calling for brakes on LLM development due to safety concerns. The shift marks a significant change in industry momentum.

cards.title: AI agents whistleblow on cheaters
cards.body: Google DeepMind's experiment showed AI agents splitting into factions and reporting cheating behavior during math problem tasks. This alignment behavior could help researchers better control AI systems.
